_README: Per-app settings for the shared Play Store scripts in the `iboalali-apps` kit.
The scripts themselves live in the plugin, not in this repo, so this file is how they learn
anything app-specific: package name, locale map, folder layout, screenshot running order, IAP
product ids. They find it by walking up from the working directory, which is also how they
refuse to run outside an app repo.
Adding a locale, a screenshot, or a product means editing this file — not a script. See the
`play-store-assets` skill for the full schema and the invocation commands.
_locales: Folder name to Play Console language code. The renderer matches a screenshot's locale token to
the entry whose LANGUAGE SUBTAG it equals, so only one entry per subtag is allowed — 'zh-CN'
here pairs with the 'Phone_zh' preview name, which renders from the b+zh+Hans resource folder.
The preview name carries the Play subtag, never the resource qualifier.
_listing: This app names its field files with underscores and 'app_name' rather than the hyphenated 'name.txt' Billboard uses, so the 'files' map is not the default.

_handMaintainedLocales: Empty: no locale's listing is maintained by hand, so the uploader pushes all nine. For the
five that were already live the push is a no-op, because their app name, short and full
description are byte-identical to `Play Store/Listing`. Dutch, Chinese, Malay and Tamil are new
text and new screenshots, and the same push is what creates them.
Naming a locale here would instead freeze its screenshots at whatever the store already holds.
_listingFiles: The uploader reads its own file map rather than the `listing.files` above, and keys the app name
`title` where that one keys it `name`. The same three files under two vocabularies, so the maps
cannot be shared. Without this the uploader looks for the kit's default hyphenated names and
stops on four locales of missing sources before it reaches the store.
_order: The store's running order, for every locale and all three device types. Display order is upload
order and the Play API has no ordering field, so this list is the only place it is decided and
changing it later means re-uploading the whole set.
It leads with the answer: the green result naming the provider, which is the one question the app
exists to answer. The idle state follows to show how that answer is reached, since the '#' button
is the entire interaction. Settings comes third and carries the most substance per pixel; on
Tablet10 it is the swipe-to-close overlay, so the large-screen layout gets a slot of its own.
About closes on reassurance, which this category needs: it does NOT root your phone, and it
LicenseShot is exported but deliberately left out: a legal credits list is weak store copy.
_render: Settings for `./scripts/generate-store-screenshots.sh`, which is a launcher for the kit's
render-store-screenshots.py. This app is the flavoured one: the task and the reference path
debugStrings is not set: the default glob app/src/debug/res/values*/strings.xml finds all
three of this app's files, which the old script listed by hand — so a fourth localized debug
app name now joins automatically instead of being missed.
slotAliases is load-bearing here, and its absence was a latent break: the 'order' above names
SettingsShot and AboutShot, which do NOT exist for Tablet10 — at >=840dp those screens render
as *DialogShot. The uploader's preflight would have failed on the first real run with 'missing
sources: .../Tablet10/AboutShot.png'. Nothing caught it because this app has never uploaded
excludeShots holds the in-app update card's four states. They are a regression baseline for a
flow otherwise only reachable through the debug 'Demo: in-app update' item, and an update
prompt is not store copy — so they render into reference/ but never into the export.

_iap: Six tip products, two per tier: a record id the app keeps and a repeat id it consumes. Both ids of a tier share one folder of copy and icon, so productFolders maps them onto the same name.
